description: This file defines the CloudStore class, which implements plugin and JSON RPC interfaces for cloud storage management, including notifications and connection handling within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: CloudStore
classes.description: Main plugin class managing cloud storage interactions, notifications, and connection lifecycle.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration container class holding the URI setting for CloudStore.

classes.name: Store2Notification
classes.description: Notification handler for store value changes, implementing IStore2::INotification.

classes.name: RemoteConnectionNotification
classes.description: Notification handler for remote connection events, implementing IRemoteConnection::INotification.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the CloudStore plugin with the provided service.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, cleaning up resources.
